brand.name: OFF THE SADDLE
brand.concept: Interactive digital exhibition for an artisan jewellery brand. Contemporary Indian visual identity, tactile, raw, editorial art direction.
brand.tagline: OBJECTS — Spatial Exhibition of Artisan Craft

text_hierarchy.display_large: font-serif text-5xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#F4F1EA]
text_hierarchy.metadata_tiny: font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs tracking-widest text-[#A3A099] uppercase
text_hierarchy.body_editorial: font-sans text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#A3A099] font-light

spatial_exhibition_layout.canvas_dimensions: 320vw width on desktop, 100vh height fixed overflow-hidden

object_placement_matrix.name: KOR-01 / MANIFOLD CUFF
object_placement_matrix.story: Hand-forged over charcoal pits in Jaipur, this cuff translates structural brutalism into wearable weight.

object_placement_matrix.name: SAD-02 / TECTONIC CHOKER
object_placement_matrix.story: Inspired by the boulder fields of Hampi. Chiseled facets catch low grazing light across dark skin.

object_placement_matrix.name: LUN-03 / ECLIPSE TALISMAN
object_placement_matrix.story: High altitude copper smithing. Each facet is struck by hand without mold or gauge.

object_placement_matrix.name: RHO-04 / STRATA SIGNET
object_placement_matrix.story: Lost-wax cast utilizing indigenous Kutchi clay molds. Dense, heavy, tactile geometry.

object_placement_matrix.name: VER-05 / SOLITUDE ORB EARRINGS
object_placement_matrix.story: A study in weightlessness and resonance. Hollow spheres spun by traditional metal lathe.

object_placement_matrix.name: SAD-06 / NOMAD ARCH PIN
object_placement_matrix.story: Forged for heavy outerwear. Pin mechanism inspired by desert saddle hardware.

object_placement_matrix.name: MON-07 / BASALT TORC
object_placement_matrix.story: Cold-forged iron fused with 925 silver. Severe mountain brutalism.

object_placement_matrix.name: OTS-08 / ARCHETYPE WRAP
object_placement_matrix.story: Multi-finger spine ring. Raw matte finish that wears down to glowing gold over time.

interactive_states_and_motion.hover_effect: Scale image to 1.08, rotate to 0deg, elevate z-index, dim non-hovered surrounding objects opacity to 0.35, reveal metadata overlay smoothly.
interactive_states_and_motion.parallax: GSAP ScrollTrigger + Lenis smooth scroll ticker alignment. Objects on layer 3 move faster than layer 1.
interactive_states_and_motion.cursor: Subtle custom cursor circle (#C4653A) with drag vector prompt 'DRAG / CLICK'.
interactive_states_and_motion.product_view_modal: Cinematic full-screen overlay (bg #0D0D0D), large photographic focal point, sticky metadata sidebar, ADD TO BAG button with immediate counter update and notification toast.
interactive_states_and_motion.menu_overlay: Full-screen minimal dark overlay, oversized Cormorant Garamond typography links (OBJECTS, ARCHIVE, MANIFESTO, ARTISANS, CONTACT), subtle rust-accented hover underline.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark editorial visual direction: Near-black #0D0D0D, off-white #F4F1EA, rust #C4653A.
Use JS React files (.js) throughout src/ components.
Ensure GSAP + Lenis are installed and synced via gsap.ticker for lag-free horizontal parallax dragging.
Never add standard e-commerce card grids, rounded corners, or bright gold gloss.
All interactive elements must include specified data-testid attributes.
